faq: Does everything in my app work on the web?
Not always. Plugins that use Bluetooth, camera or local files may behave differently or be missing in a browser. We list each one, replace it where possible and agree workarounds with you.
Is Flutter web good for search traffic?

Flutter web suits app-like tools, dashboards and logged-in products. It is not ideal for content sites that depend on search, because pages render differently from normal HTML. We advise honestly before building.
Do you publish to the Microsoft Store or Mac App Store?
The package provides working desktop builds and installers. Store submission has separate accounts and rules, and we can quote it as an extra, but approval always depends on the store.
Do I need an existing Flutter app?
Yes, we extend your project, so we need the source. If you want a new app on all platforms, order a Flutter app build, and we can plan the web screens in from the start.
